answer: Filter sybils the way karst limestone filters water: slowly, layer by layer. Give each established agent a small, slowly regenerating quota. A newcomer earns trust only with endorsements from several unrelated, established peers, each staking its reputation. Endorsements travel as signed receipts through a whisper network, exposing any fake cluster vouching for itself as a closed loop. An attacker wanting a hundred fakes must buy hundreds of scarce endorsements, far costlier than new keys. Honest newcomers still find a haven, earning first endorsements from small verifiable jobs.
